notes: LumaForge is a self-contained browser photo editor with a procedural sample image, non-destructive adjustment controls and editable overlay layers, crop/paint/erase/type/shape/gradient/eyedropper/pan tools, transforms, undo/redo, local autosave, and PNG/JPEG/WebP export. JavaScript syntax, metadata JSON, and HTML structure received code-level checks. Headless Chromium could not be launched in this environment, so interactive browser behavior, file import/export, persistence, and performance were not runtime-verified.
